mapper.select: /* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getCountOutlierFileInfo */ SELECT ORIGIN_META_SEQ, SDT_UNIQ_ID, SDT_NM, SDT_DATA_URL, SDT_VER, SDT_CRT_DT, REG_DT FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SDT_VER DESC) AS rn, a.* FROM TB_META_ORIGIN a WHERE SDT_UNIQ_ID = #{sdtUniqId}) sub WHERE rn = 1

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getCountOutlierFileInfo */ SELECT CASE WHEN SDT_ITEM_DEPTH_VALUE IS NULL THEN SDT_ITEM_ENG_NM ELSE CONCAT(SDT_ITEM_DEPTH_VALUE, '.', SDT_ITEM_ENG_NM) END AS SDT_ITEM_ENG_NM FROM TB_META_ORIGIN_ITEM A WHERE ORIGIN_META_SEQ = #{origin_meta_seq}
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getDtPreprocLastFile */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_MODEL_FILES WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmList */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_MODEL_ALGRM A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getUnitCodeList */ SELECT * FROM TB_UNIT A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getUnitTpList */ SELECT * FROM TB_UNIT A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.UNIT_TP = #{unit} ORDER BY A.ORDBY

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getModelAlgorithmParamsList */ SELECT A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ, A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP, A.MODEL_PARAMS_DERPN, B.MODEL_SEQ, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM, B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_VALUE, (SELECT T.MODEL_ALGRM FROM TB_META_MODEL_ALGRM T WHERE A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = T.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y') MODEL_ALGRM_NM FROM TB_META_MODEL_ITEM A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_META_MODEL_PARAMS B ON A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} WHERE A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = #{model_algrm_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmCodeList */ SELECT DTL_CD , DTL_CD_NM , REF_CD , REF_CLASS , REF_VALUE , ORDBY FROM TB_CODE_DTL WHERE GRP_CD = #{grp_cd} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY, DTL_CD_NM

/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgorithmModelParamsCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_META_MODEL_PARAMS A JOIN TB_META_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq}
/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : getModelLoss */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_MODEL_LOSS WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EPOCHS
/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : getModelFID */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_MODEL_FID WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EPOCHS
/* file : DTModelMapper.xml, id : getEtcModelInfo */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_FILES WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etc_model_seq} AND REF_TP = 'MODEL' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS result FROM (SELECT MODEL.MODEL_SEQ, MODEL.MODEL_NM, ITEM.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE, CASE WHEN JSON_SEARCH( ITEM.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE, 'one', CAST(#{model_seq} AS CHAR), NULL, '$.preproc_property_info[*].preproc_property[*].preproc_set[*].etc_model_seq' ) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FIND FROM TB_META_USER_ITEM_PREPROCESS_MAP_OUTLR AS OUTLIER INNER JOIN TB_META_USER_ITEM AS ITEM ON ITEM.USER_META_ITEM_SEQ = OUTLIER.USER_META_ITEM_SEQ INNER JOIN TB_META_MODEL AS MODEL ON MODEL.MODEL_SEQ = ITEM.MODEL_SEQ AND MODEL.USE_YN = 'Y' AND MODEL.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE OUTLIER.OUTLR_PRCS_TP = 'autoencoder') AS subquery WHERE FIND = 1;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS result FROM (SELECT MODEL.MODEL_SEQ, MODEL.MODEL_NM, ITEM.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE, CASE WHEN JSON_SEARCH( ITEM.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE, 'one', CAST(#{model_seq} AS CHAR), NULL, '$.preproc_property_info[*].preproc_property[*].preproc_set[*].interpl_etc_model_seq' ) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FIND FROM TB_META_USER_ITEM_PREPROCESS_MAP_INTERPL AS OUTLIER INNER JOIN TB_META_USER_ITEM AS ITEM ON ITEM.USER_META_ITEM_SEQ = OUTLIER.USER_META_ITEM_SEQ INNER JOIN TB_META_MODEL AS MODEL ON MODEL.MODEL_SEQ = ITEM.MODEL_SEQ AND MODEL.USE_YN = 'Y' AND MODEL.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE OUTLIER.INTERPL_TP = 'random forest') AS subquery WHERE FIND = 1;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS result FROM (SELECT MODEL.MODEL_SEQ, MODEL.MODEL_NM, ITEM.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE, CASE WHEN JSON_SEARCH( ITEM.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE, 'one', CAST(#{model_seq} AS CHAR), NULL, '$.preproc_property_info[*].preproc_property[*].preproc_set[*].interpl_etc_model_seq' ) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FIND FROM TB_META_USER_ITEM_PREPROCESS_MAP_INTERPL AS OUTLIER INNER JOIN TB_META_USER_ITEM AS ITEM ON ITEM.USER_META_ITEM_SEQ = OUTLIER.USER_META_ITEM_SEQ INNER JOIN TB_META_MODEL AS MODEL ON MODEL.MODEL_SEQ = ITEM.MODEL_SEQ AND MODEL.USE_YN = 'Y' AND MODEL.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE OUTLIER.INTERPL_TP = 'brits') AS subquery WHERE FIND = 1;
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_META_MODEL SET USE_YN= 'N', DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_USER_SEQ = #{user_seq}, DEL_DT = now(), DEL_IP = #{user_ip} WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq}
UPDATE TB_META_MODEL_LOSS SET DEL_YN = 'Y', USE_YN = 'N' WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq}
UPDATE TB_META_MODEL_FID SET DEL_YN = 'Y', USE_YN = 'N' WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq}
